positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Capital One Convergence Metric Service: Led and implemented a scalability metrics service to evaluate platform readiness of 13 Discover services ahead of the Discover and Capital One integration, equipping executive leadership with predictive capacity data to de-risk system convergence.
- Architected and developed a self-service platform to provide Product teams the ability to update their Scalability metrics in real time.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Designing and implementing features for Amazon's Environmental, Health, and Safety Management System.
- Client Onboarding Efficiency: Designed and implemented microservices, reducing client onboarding overhead from 10 weeks to 2 weeks through a new multi-tenant process.
- Driver Safety Alerts: Promoted safety to Amazon delivery drivers by creating a dog notification mechanism at a customer’s home, integrated into Amazon’s iOS delivery application.
- Reduced Translation Overhead: Decreased translation request load by 66%, from 150k requests per day to 20k, improving response time from 2-3 hours to instantaneous.
- RPC API Development: Designed and implemented RPC APIs across various services, enabling seamless communication and integration for external clients, improving system scalability and efficiency.
positions.insights: Kotlin, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +11 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Currently contributing to Amazon's backend Environment, Health, and Safety information management system.
- Previously developed software to enhance the safety of Amazon delivery drivers via Amazon's mobile application.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed and implemented a Candidate Chatbot to handle candidate inquiries.
- Using Angular, designed a chatbox with the following features: candidate checkup, receipt download, automated email support from the recruitment team, an autocomplete chat feature, and navigating candidates to appropriate sites if requested.
- Using HTML and CSS, implemented the AMEX site for the AfroTech event.
